title: ColorDefinition - Data API
description: Represents the color-related metadata for a custom tab. This object is available in API version 43.0 and later.

Color.description: The color described in web color RGB format—for example, “00FF00”.

Context.description: The color context, which determines whether the color is the main color (or primary) for the tab.

DurableId.description: A unique virtual Salesforce ID for the color.

TabDefinitionId.description: The TabDefinition ID. This is a relationship field.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="ColorDefinition">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="Color" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="Context" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="DurableId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="TabDefinition" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:TabDefinition"/>
        <element name="TabDefinitionId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="Theme" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```
